title: Nauseous Lite
body:
# Nausea Customized

Nausea Customized is a client-side mod for Forge 1.20.1 that adds control-based disorientation to the Nausea effect. It focuses on disrupting muscle memory rather than just visual filters.

### Features
All effects are modular and togglable in the configuration:
- **Movement Inversion:** Reverse W/S and A/D keys.
- **Key Swaps:** Swap Jump (Space) and Sneak (Shift) functionality.
- **Interaction Swaps:** Swap Left-Click (Attack) and Right-Click (Use) with full support for bows, tridents, and food.
- **Mouse Inversion:** Independently flip horizontal and vertical look axes.

### Level-Based Configuration
The mod uses a list-based effects at specific Nausea levels. For example, you can set Mouse Y to invert only at Nausea II. If a level is not in the config list, controls remain normal.

### Technical Details
- **Client-Side:** Works on any server without server-side installation.
- **Config Path:** `config/nausea_customized-client.toml`
